name: Haggler
description:
Your time in the floating markets of Ikeda have taught you that you should never pay the asking price.

Each time you purchase an equipment item, roll Persuade against a Difficulty equal to the item's cost, in Treasure. On a pass, choose one:

  • You may purchase the item for 1 less Treasure than its listed cost (minimum 1 Treasure).

  • You may purchase the item for its listed cost and receive another item costing at least 2 Treasure less for free.

Whenever you sell Equipment, you always get ¾ of its original cost instead of ½.

Describe how you strike a bargain.
